architecture.public_source_registration: util::workerqueue and util::source::workerqueue name the same source module
architecture.resource_owner: Context owns one ready/dirty/processing state, one limiter and one parent cancellation token. DelayLoop owns native timers and the deadline-to-timer index.

ecosystem_reuse.custom_policy_reason: The selected runtime/timer/channel facilities do not own Agones dirty/in-flight deduplication or its max-of per-key and global reservation delay policy. The small typed policy state composes those facilities; it does not recreate a runtime, a generic Go queue or a Go rate package.
ecosystem_reuse.dependency_change: Enabled time on the existing selected tokio-util; slab 0.4.12 was already present. The slab dependency edge was observed in Cargo.lock after the manifest edit; actor attribution is unconfirmed. No Cargo command or dependency-resolution success is credited.
ecosystem_reuse.native_timer_resolution: DelayQueue uses native millisecond timer resolution. Equal deadlines have native library ordering. No Go timer equivalence is claimed.
ecosystem_reuse.range_policy: Duration/Instant checked arithmetic reports unrepresentable deadlines. A one-day timer horizon retains long representable policy deadlines without passing oversized delays into the library timer wheel.
